approach.story: A wedding is not a sequence of events to be documented. It is a room full of people who have known each other for decades, a grandmother who has waited years for this morning, and quiet glances that carry the weight of a lifetime.
paragraphs: A wedding is not a sequence of events to be documented. It is a room full of people who have known each other for decades, a grandmother who has waited years for this morning, a friendship that changes shape by the end of the night.

We work quietly and from the edges - reading relationships before we raise a camera, letting atmosphere and detail carry as much weight as the ceremony itself. The result is an archive that feels less like a wedding album and more like a year you can walk back into.

pillars.title: Unobtrusive Presence
pillars.description: We work quietly from the edges, reading connections before we ever raise a lens.

pillars.title: Emotional Truth
